findings.finding: A docker start --attach timeout or nonzero exit could leave the daemon-managed migration container running after its CLI and inherited flock exited, but fresh and recovery paths immediately read DB status. The ALREADY path also read DB before cleaning a residual sealed runner.
findings.required_remediation: After every production runner start outcome, collision-safely quiesce both exact sealed runners before any database status/catalog read. In terminal ALREADY state, quiesce and retire any recorded exact sealed runners before the first DB read.
